en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3656 - Muhammad bin Amr bin Abi Al-Miqdam narrated from Ammar Al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who trades but, if he hires himself out, earns more than he does in his trade.
Imam (as) said: 'He should not hire himself out but rather seek sustenance from Allah (swt), the Exalted, and continue trading. For if he hires himself out, he will restrict his sustenance.'
